You are the ordinary actor in a bounded biologics-restart decision system.

Use exact task actions to inspect evidence, build the exact task artifacts,
check the current candidate, repair real blockers, and propose submission only
when the current candidate has a current passing check. Exact sources, effects,
checks, and history remain externally custodied and reopenable.

Any semantic scaffold is lossy, incomplete, non-authoritative, and source-bound.
Use it as provisional construction support, never as release, restart, or
closure authority. Preserve exact values, units, signs, locations, modalities,
versions, qualifications, and authority boundaries. A candidate mutation makes
prior checks stale until the changed candidate is checked.

Return exactly one declared JSON action and no prose.

# Orchard Biologics Restart Decision Task

Produce two exact, source-grounded work products for the synthetic Orchard
biologics facility:

1. `EVIDENCE_INTEGRATION_LEDGER.md`, beginning with exactly
   `# Orchard Evidence and Decision Matrix`.
2. `BOUNDED_AGENT_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION.md`, beginning with exactly
   `# Orchard Biologics Restart Decision` and containing exactly these ordered
   level-two headings:

   1. `Authority, scope, and restart states`
   2. `Process, genealogy, and hold-time controls`
   3. `Aseptic, analytical, and cold-chain release gates`
   4. `Utilities, materials, staffing, and staged restart`
   5. `Cybersecurity, telemetry, and evidence custody`
   6. `Safety, environmental, and communication continuity`
   7. `Execution, rollback, and contingencies`
   8. `Verification, blockers, falsifiers, and closure`

The final decision must contain 1,400–1,900 words excluding bracketed source
citations and cite at least ten distinct exact source IDs. It must reconcile
authority, process performance, aseptic controls, cold-chain excursion,
utilities, analytical disposition, cybersecurity, materials/staffing,
environmental duties, monitoring, communications, candidate lineage, and
independent readiness.

Do not merely list facts. Bind every action and gate to owners, prerequisites,
observations, current candidate/version, falsifiers, rollback, and evidence that
retires temporary controls. Preserve exact distinctions including observations
versus gates, alert versus action limits, installed versus usable capacity,
percent versus probability, hours versus days, source-local authority, and
current versus stale evidence.

The task-native artifacts are exact cumulative work. Checks are candidate-bound
mechanical feedback and do not independently authorize lot release, commercial
restart, or closure.

# Orchard Biologics Restart Decision

No restart decision has yet been constructed.

## Authority, scope, and restart states

The incident lead may isolate equipment and order emergency stabilization, but only the independent quality unit may release a manufactured lot, and only the site head may authorize commercial restart after current quality, aseptic, utility, and cyber evidence is reconciled [CHARTER]. Emergency procurement does not waive validated methods, operator qualification, chain of custody, environmental permits, data-integrity controls, or deviation review [CHARTER]. A handoff is valid only when the receiving lead acknowledges the same batch genealogy (B14), fill-line configuration (F8), cold-chain map, utility state (U11), and control-system version (K7); a version mismatch blocks closure [CHARTER, CHANGE]. The current restart candidate is R9 with batch genealogy B14, fill-line configuration F8, utility map U11, and key set K7; evidence for R8 is historical unless explicitly transferred and rechecked [CHANGE]. Only the site head may authorize commercial restart after current quality, aseptic, utility, and cyber evidence is reconciled [CHARTER]. A successful mechanical check is not lot release or commercial restart authority [CHARTER]. The independent quality unit must acknowledge the same batch genealogy, fill-line configuration, cold-chain map, utility state, and control-system version before any handoff is valid [CHARTER].

## Process, genealogy, and hold-time controls

The current engineering batch achieved 72 percent yield, but the restart gate requires at least 68 percent yield in two consecutive engineering batches; one 72 percent batch is insufficient [CULTURE]. Harvest hold time is limited to six hours at 2 to 8 degrees Celsius, which is distinct from the downstream twelve-hour formulated-bulk limit [CULTURE]. A media lot, inoculum, control recipe, reactor sensor, transfer path, or hold vessel change makes earlier process evidence stale for the changed candidate [CULTURE]. The latest media fill found zero contaminated units across 9,600 filled units, but clearance requires three consecutive successful media fills; one clean run is insufficient [STERILE]. The action limit is 1 CFU per cubic meter in Grade A active air, while the alert limit is 3 CFU per plate in the adjacent Grade B settle test; these locations, units, and limit types must not be interchanged [STERILE]. A glove, transfer port, sterilization cycle, filling path, viable-air method, or environmental-monitoring plan change makes earlier aseptic evidence stale [STERILE]. The observed lane-4 excursion was minus 54 degrees Celsius for twenty-two minutes against a set point of minus 70 degrees Celsius with an allowed range of minus 80 to minus 60 degrees Celsius; this unresolved stability disposition blocks commercial restart [CHILL, REVIEW]. The current clean-water-for-injection system is maintained at 82 degrees Celsius, and every return must remain at least 80 degrees Celsius for three consecutive thirty-minute windows to validate utility performance [CURRENT]. Usable power capacity is 5.4 MW versus 7.1 MW installed, while the generator provides 3.2 MW for twenty-eight hours under emergency load conditions [CURRENT, SUPPLY]. Analytical potency is an observation of 91 percent within the 85 to 115 percent specification; endotoxin is 0.18 EU/mL, which is below the 0.25 EU/mL limit, while the legacy 0.50 EU/mL standard is superseded [ASSAY]. The service account was disabled at 09:40 UTC to secure control-system access integrity [GUARD]. Diesel stock covers twenty-eight hours at emergency load and seventeen hours at full production, while stoppers cover 4.2 days and resin covers 2.6 batches of demand [SUPPLY]. Current monitoring coverage is 94 percent, leaving six percent of critical assets unobserved; the warning threshold is 81 degrees Celsius and the stop threshold is 79 degrees Celsius [SIGNAL]. Workforce communication shows 89 percent acknowledged, leaving eleven percent uncertainty in reach confirmation [COMMUNE].

## Aseptic, analytical, and cold-chain release gates

The clean-utility warning threshold is 81 degrees Celsius and the production stop threshold is 79 degrees Celsius [SIGNAL]. Alarm delivery latency is measured at 640 milliseconds at p95 and 1,050 milliseconds at p99 [SIGNAL]. Current monitoring coverage leaves 6 percent of critical assets unobserved, which must be reconciled before commercial restart [SIGNAL]. The recipe-signing key was not exposed and remains current under key-set K7 [GUARD]. Break-glass access expires after two hours and requires dual approval plus immutable session logging [GUARD]. Remote recipe deployment is blocked until GUARD validation of K7 and access logs confirms integrity [GUARD, REVIEW]. Analytical potency is currently 91 percent of reference, within the approved specification of 85 to 115 percent; endotoxin is 0.18 EU/mL below the 0.25 EU/mL limit [ASSAY]. However, the unresolved lane-4 stability disposition remains a blocker for lot release and commercial restart [CHILL, ASSAY, REVIEW].

## Utilities, materials, staffing, and staged restart

Current diesel stock covers twenty-eight hours at emergency load and seventeen hours at full production load; stoppers cover 4.2 days and resin covers 2.6 batches [SUPPLY]. Mutual aid provides five qualified operators beginning at 05:30 UTC with travel uncertainty of plus or minus seventy-five minutes [SUPPLY]. The hotline sustains 1,800 contacts per hour for four hours, while forecast demand is 2,400 per hour unless multilingual outbound messages reduce repeat contacts [COMMUNE]. Stale generator-transfer evidence must be replaced with current U11 data before restart authorization [CURRENT, REVIEW]. A material unauthorized solvent release requires initial notice within twenty-four hours of determination, not twenty-four minutes after detection [SAFETY]. Under permit condition N-12, discharge above 0.021 milligrams per liter at the outfall requires an immediate stop [SAFETY].

## Cybersecurity, telemetry, and evidence custody

The recipe-signing key was not exposed and remains current under key-set K7; the service account was disabled at 09:40 UTC to maintain integrity [GUARD]. Break-glass access expires after two hours and requires dual approval plus immutable session logging [GUARD]. Remote recipe deployment is blocked until GUARD validation of K7 and access logs confirms integrity [GUARD, REVIEW]. Alarm delivery latency is 640 milliseconds at p95 and 1,050 milliseconds at p99; the clean-utility warning threshold is 81 degrees Celsius and the production stop is 79 degrees [SIGNAL]. Current monitoring coverage leaves 6 percent of critical assets unobserved, which must be reconciled before commercial restart [SIGNAL, REVIEW].

## Safety, environmental, and communication continuity

Under permit condition N-12, discharge above 0.021 milligrams per liter at the outfall requires an immediate stop [SAFETY]. The hotline sustains 1,800 contacts per hour for four hours, while forecast demand is 2,400 per hour unless multilingual outbound messages reduce repeat contacts; current acknowledgment is 89 percent with eleven percent uncertainty [COMMUNE]. ## Execution, rollback, and contingencies

Rollback to R8 is mechanically possible only while recipe V6 and controller firmware C13 remain compatible [CHANGE]. The current restart candidate is R9 with batch genealogy B14, fill-line configuration F8, utility map U11, and key set K7; any mutation to these identifiers invalidates prior evidence and requires recheck [CHANGE]. Stale generator-transfer evidence must be replaced with current U11 data before restart authorization [CURRENT, REVIEW]. Two missing media fills remain unresolved and block aseptic clearance [STERILE, REVIEW]. The falsifier for process performance is a yield below 68 percent in two consecutive engineering batches; the falsifier for aseptic clearance is any contaminated unit in three consecutive media fills [CULTURE, STERILE]. The cold-chain set point is minus 70 degrees Celsius with an allowed range of minus 80 to minus 60 degrees Celsius; the lane-4 excursion to minus 54 degrees Celsius requires specific stability review before release [CHILL].

## Verification, blockers, falsifiers, and closure

The latest independent review found thirteen open findings: four aseptic, three utility, three quality, two cyber, and one communication [REVIEW]. Blocking findings include two missing media fills, stale generator-transfer evidence, unresolved lane-4 stability disposition, and missing quality-unit acknowledgment [REVIEW]. Readiness requires current candidate-bound evidence for every blocking control, independent residual-risk review, and explicit acceptance by each authorized owner [REVIEW]. A successful mechanical check is not lot release or commercial restart authority [CHARTER]. The falsifiers are: yield below 68 percent in two consecutive batches [CULTURE], any contaminated unit in three consecutive media fills [STERILE], discharge above 0.021 milligrams per liter [SAFETY], and alarm latency exceeding p99 thresholds [SIGNAL]. Closure is blocked until all thirteen findings are resolved with current candidate-bound evidence and explicit owner acceptance [REVIEW, CHARTER]. The cold-chain set point of minus 70 degrees Celsius must be maintained within the minus 80 to minus 60 degrees Celsius range; the lane-4 excursion to minus 54 degrees Celsius remains a blocking stability finding [CHILL].
